scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/citation-parser && npm run build -w packages/rule-engine && npm run build -w packages/verification && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/citation-parser && npm run build -w packages/rule-engine && npm run build -w packages/verification && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/citation-parser packages/rule-engine packages/verification apps/api apps/web
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree > /dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
